description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for changing the 'instance mode' in the Fineract system, primarily for testing purposes. It includes an endpoint to modify the system's read/write capabilities, batch worker, and batch manager features, with appropriate logging and configuration updates.

classes.name: InstanceModeApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource for changing the instance mode, primarily used in testing environments.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method that logs a warning about not using this API in production and indicates that instance mode changing is enabled.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: API endpoint to update the system's mode settings (read, write, batch worker, batch manager) based on the request payload.
